quote: If there's a lock, there's a way.
bio: Talin always has a plan (and a plan B). Curious, bold, and with a smile that opens more doors than a key.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.effect: Extra damage once per turn if she has advantage or an ally is engaged with the target.

abilities.name: Nimble Fingers
abilities.effect: Picking locks, disarming traps, and picking pockets are Sleight of Hand checks with advantage.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.effect: Can disengage or hide as part of the same move, without spending her action.

goal: Find the treasure her grandmother used to talk about, if it even exists.
